beats.say: Now you are a regular employee, and you want to see your payslip.
The top search result is often an ad. Fraudsters place fake portals there as ads.
The fake page looks just like the real one. Type your password, and your account and then your salary account can change.
Type the portal address yourself or open it from a bookmark. And keep two-step verification on.

question.prompt: You searched for "kadr kabineti". How do you get in?

options.label: Ad: Kadr Kabineti, official sign-in (kadr-kabineti-giris.example.net)
options.feedback: Ad space is bought, so a fake site can sit at the very top. This domain is not your office's domain.

options.label: kadr-kabineti.example.org: payslip
options.feedback: The name looks similar, but the domain is not your office's. A look-alike name is the most common trick.

options.label: I type it myself: kabinet.seherxidmetleri.example
options.feedback: Correct. An address you type or saved as a bookmark does not depend on ads.

scenes.explain: Fraudsters use search ads to push fake portals to the top. Check the portal address once and save it as a bookmark.

scenes.title: Payslip
scenes.intro: You opened the browser to see your payslip. Watch the address bar and make the right call at every step.

steps.label: Ad: Kadr Kabineti, official payslip sign-in

actions.label: Open the ad result
actions.feedback: This ad leads to a fake portal. Your office's domain is not in the address bar.

actions.label: Open Kadr Kabineti from bookmarks
actions.feedback: Correct. A bookmark always takes you to the real address.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: Your password went to the fraudster. Change it on the real portal right away and call human resources.

actions.label: Close tab
actions.feedback: Right, the domain is not your office's. Open the portal from your bookmarks.

steps.say: Now the site asks for the code sent to your phone.

actions.label: Confirm
actions.feedback: With the code, the fraudster gets fully into your account. Only type a code on the real site, when you are the one signing in.

actions.label: Close tab
actions.feedback: Good thing you stopped. Now change your password on the real portal and tell human resources.

steps.say: This is your office's own address.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: Correct. The domain belongs to your office and you opened the page yourself.

actions.label: Close tab
actions.feedback: This is the real portal. Once you have checked the address, signing in is safe.

body.text: Turn it on now to protect your account. Your phone will confirm every sign-in.

actions.label: Turn on
actions.feedback: Well done. Even if your password is stolen, the second step blocks a stranger.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Without two-step verification, one password opens everything. Turn it on today.

steps.label: Your bank details: last changed 14.03.2025 by human resources

actions.label: Check the account
actions.feedback: Good habit. If you see a change you did not make, call human resources right away.

actions.label: Leave without looking
actions.feedback: If a stranger changed it, you would only find out on payday. A quick look takes seconds.

body.text: I am in a meeting and cannot call. Quickly buy five 100 manat BonusMarket cards and send me the codes here. I will pay you back.

cards.explain: A gift card code is like cash and never comes back. Call your manager on a number you know to check.

messages.text: Salary of 1,240.00 AZN credited to your card. Balance: 1,386.50 AZN.

cards.explain: There is no link and it asks for nothing. This is a normal information message.

messages.text: Your salary is on hold. Update your bank details:

cards.explain: Human resources never restores a salary through a text message link. Open the portal yourself or call the team.

body.text: See the Salary section in the portal.

cards.explain: This notification has no link and points you to the portal you know. Open it from your bookmarks.

body.text: You will get a code from Kadr Kabineti, tell it to me so I can fix the payroll sheet.

cards.explain: A sign-in code is for you alone. Whoever gets your code gets into your account.

scenes.prompt: You typed your password on a fake portal. Put the steps in order.

items.label: Change the password on the real portal now
Call human resources and the security team
Check bank details and recent sign-ins together

scenes.explain: First change the password, then call so any bank detail change is stopped. If you also typed a code, be sure to say so.

points: Open the portal from a bookmark, not from search.
Check gift card and code requests by phone.
